name: RoboMaster 17mm Fluorescent Projectile (17mm荧光弹丸)
license: n/a (no CAD needed: geometry is a plain sphere).
model_exactly_as: smooth solid sphere, diameter 16.8 mm (radius 8.4 mm); official tolerance +/-0.2 mm. No dimples, seams or holes are described for this projectile.
material: TPU plastic, hardness 90 Shore A (spec: 90 HA)

colors.unlit: pale yellow-green (glow-in-the-dark pigment), matte; median of the official photo (through the bag, on white) is about #CED09D
colors.glowing: emits yellow-green light after being charged with 390-410 nm UV (that is what projectile-charger does)

pack: 500 pcs per bag; USD 155 / RMB 799 per bag
notes: Status no-cad only because no file is needed: the official spec fully defines the shape (sphere). It replaced the plain 17 mm projectile in 2019/2020 and is still the competition 17 mm ammo in the 2026 season (RMUC 2026 projectile-control notice 1917).
